units: <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:16">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>כמאן תלינן כבסא בדיקלא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>כּוּבְסֵי</he>, Ms. O. <he>כְּבָסֵי</he> pl., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) by what authority dare we suspend a cluster of dates on a sterile date-tree (and not consider it a forbidden superstitious practice)? <cite ref="Makkot 8a:3">Macc. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ומחייה לכ׳</he> (ed. <he>לכְּבָאסָא</he>, Ms. M. a. Rashi <he>לכובסא</he>) and it (the struck twig) struck the cluster.

<cite ref="Shevuot 41a:8">Shebu. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>נקטיה בכוּבְסֵיה … לגלימיה הוא</he> that is “held him by his testicles that he may give up his cloak’; i.e. this is force worse than laying distress on his property; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 101b">B. Mets. 101ᵇ</cite>
